deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 (domestic and international); letters also due December 1.
deadline.quote: International Applicants F (student) or J (exchange visitor) visas; A,E,G,H,I and L visas and immigrants December 1, 2026

also.quote: The application deadline for both domestic and international applicants is December 1 for admission in the next fall semester.

gre_general.value: NACS does not require GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: We do not require GRE scores.

supervisor.value: Admission is mentor-based: only applicants a faculty member has expressed interest in are considered, so contact potential mentors before applying.
supervisor.quote: We therefore strongly suggest that you contact potential mentors before applying to the program. | Only applicants in whom faculty members have expressed interest will be considered for admission.

funding.value: Fellowships are competitive; TA posts and some faculty RA posts are available.
funding.quote: Fellowships are available on a competitive basis to both entering and continuing students, while qualified students may also receive teaching assistantships.

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked.

notes: Interdepartmental program; shortlisted applicants are interviewed and invited to NACS-Fest in February.
